pixel_convention: original 2160x1080 pixels, x right, y down, origin top-left

camera.evidence: phase correlation of 3 static regions vs frame 0: max |shift| 0.51 px over all frames
camera.view: elevated camera looking down a straight cobbled street across an intersection; street runs away from camera; roll ~0
camera.horizon_note: horizon above the image top (camera pitched down). Cross-street curbs are horizontal in the image -> horizon ~ horizontal line y ~ -120.
camera.street_width_rule: carriageway width between curb lines ~ 1.708*(y+121) px: linear in row, zero at horizon -> a ground point at row y has distance-along-street proportional to 1/(y+121)
camera.frame0_equals_frame1: frame 1 is a near-duplicate of frame 0 (mean abs diff 0.015 grey levels); motion starts between frames 1 and 2

taxi.desc: yellow NYC-style taxi sedan (roof sign), the only yellow car
taxi.motion: starts facing the camera just left of street centre (bbox centre ~(943,260) at f0), drives toward camera while turning to its right (image left) into the cross street, ends travelling right-to-left along the near side of the cross street, side-on; still moving at f71
taxi.ref_point: bbox centre; bottom_y = lowest mask row (tyre contact, +~10 px ground shadow)
taxi.occlusion: behind the left traffic-signal head/pole from f38 on (bbox still spans the car; rear upper part hidden)

van.desc: white/light-grey full-size passenger van (Chevrolet Express style), driver visible
van.motion: drives straight toward the camera down the right-centre of the street the whole clip; apparent size grows ~2.1x (bbox w 130->274 px); image motion accelerates strongly in the last frames (top y +33 px between f70 and f71)
van.ref_point: bbox centre; bottom_y = bottom of black region under bumper (= approx front-wheel ground line; true bumper edge 0-30 px higher)

cyclist.desc: person in dark clothes riding a bicycle toward the camera, between the taxi and van at start
cyclist.motion: rides toward the camera along the street, drifting slightly left (body x 1054 -> 1031); height 86 -> 169 px
cyclist.ref_point: x = centre of body column band; pelvis_est = wheel_bottom - 0.57*height (saddle, rough)
cyclist.occlusion: none, but rides through the van shadow (f29-f70): bbox width/edges noisy there; use smoothed head/wheel columns

pedestrian.desc: man in white T-shirt and dark trousers walking on the far-left sidewalk (beyond the cross street)
pedestrian.hidden_frames: 0-32 behind the left signal head (only feet glimpsed: x~452,y~290 at f0; x~355 at f24)
pedestrian.motion: walks right-to-left (image), roughly parallel to the image plane, at near-constant depth (feet y ~298-300)
pedestrian.ref_point: x = mask centroid; pelvis_est = head_top + 0.47*Href, Href = median full height f36-52 = 103 px
pedestrian.occlusion: legs/feet hidden behind the taxi from ~f53-57 on (feet_visible=0)

traffic_signal_near_left.desc: vehicle signal head (black, yellow border) on pole at near-left corner, with white warning sign above and green pedestrian signal below

traffic_signal_near_right.desc: signal head with green light, pedestrian-crossing sign above, pedestrian signal below, near-right corner

traffic_signal_far_left.note: far corner beyond cross street, green light

trees.note: trunks in square planters on the far sidewalks

street_far.desc: cobbled street continuing away from camera between far sidewalks

cross_street.desc: sunlit cobbled cross street spanning full width

street_near.desc: cobbled street toward camera (bottom of frame) between near sidewalks

static_objects.sidewalks: grey paved corners near-left (x<600, y>550) and near-right (x>1810, y>540); far sidewalks y~150-310
static_objects.grate: dark grate/manhole at near-left sidewalk edge, bbox approx [0, 610, 110, 720]
static_objects.shadows: large tree/building shadows on the near road (static); van and taxi cast shadows toward image left

events.what: first visible motion of taxi, van, cyclist
pedestrian emerges from behind the left signal head
taxi front reaches the left signal pole/head (partial occlusion begins)
taxi passes in front of pedestrian; pedestrian legs hidden from here
end; all four still moving; no contact/collision anywhere
